name: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra
display: 6.9" Dynamic LTPO AMOLED 2X, 120Hz, HDR10+, 2600 nits, 1440 x 3120 px
connectivity: 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, UWB, USB-C 3.2 DisplayPort
pros: Unmatched anti-reflective Gorilla Armor flat screen
Integrated S-Pen stylus with full Bluetooth gestures
7 years of major OS and security updates guaranteed
Best-in-class 200MP camera and dual telephoto zoom
verdictReasonEn: The definitive Android flagship. Superb durability, class-leading camera versatility, and 7 years of software support justify the high price.
verdictReasonAr: الهاتف الأقوى بدون منازع في عالم أندرويد. شاشة خارقة مضادة للانعكاس، كاميرات جبارة، ودعم لـ 7 سنوات كاملة تجعله استثماراً ممتازاً.

name: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max
display: 6.9" LTPO Super Retina XDR OLED, 120Hz ProMotion, 2000 nits, 1320 x 2868 px
chipset: Apple A18 Pro (3nm), 6-core GPU Hardware Ray Tracing
os: iOS 18 (with Apple Intelligence), 6 Years of Updates
connectivity: 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.3, NFC, UWB, USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps)
pros: Tremendous battery endurance, longest in iPhone history
Studio-grade 4K@120fps video recording and Audio Mix
Dedicated Camera Control tactile haptic button
Grade 5 Titanium frame with Ceramic Shield
cons: Camera Control button takes time to get used to
Modest charging speed compared to Android rivals
verdictReasonEn: The gold standard for content creators. Incredible battery longevity and unmatched video recording quality.
verdictReasonAr: الخيار الأول لصناع المحتوى ومحبي آبل. بطارية هي الأطول في تاريخ آيفون مع تصوير فيديو احترافي 4K بمعدل 120 إطاراً.

name: Google Pixel 9 Pro
display: 6.3" Super Actua LTPO OLED, 120Hz, 3000 nits, 1280 x 2856 px
pros: Pro camera features in a compact, hand-friendly 6.3" body
Market-leading still photography and natural skin tones
Generous 16GB RAM standard across all models
7 years of Pixel Feature Drops and OS updates
cons: Tensor G4 is weaker for heavy 3D gaming
verdictReasonEn: Unrivaled point-and-shoot camera quality in a comfortable compact size. Highly recommended for photography enthusiasts.
verdictReasonAr: قمة التصوير الفوتوغرافي ونقاء أندرويد في حجم أنيق ومريح لليد مع 16 جيجا رام و7 سنوات تحديثات.

name: Xiaomi 15 Ultra
display: 6.73" LTPO AMOLED, 120Hz, Dolby Vision, 3200 nits, 1440 x 3200 px
cameras: 50MP 1-inch Main (OIS) + 200MP Periscope (4.3x) + 50MP Tele (3x) + 50MP Ultrawide Leica | 32MP Front
pros: Massive 1-inch main sensor plus 200MP periscope zoom
Huge 6000mAh battery with 90W wired and 80W wireless
IP69 certified for high water pressure resistance
Authentic Leica optical lenses and color tuning
cons: Large camera bump makes device top-heavy
HyperOS has occasional background service delays
verdictReasonEn: The reigning camera monster. Dual periscope zoom and 1-inch sensor deliver unrivaled low-light and portrait clarity.
verdictReasonAr: وحش الكاميرات المطلق. الجمع بين مستشعر 1 إنش وكاميرا زوم 200 ميجابكسل مع بطارية 6000 وشحن 90 واط.

name: OnePlus 13
display: 6.82" LTPO 4.0 AMOLED, 120Hz, Dolby Vision, 4500 nits, 1440 x 3168 px
cameras: 50MP Sony LYT-808 (OIS) + 50MP Periscope (3x) + 50MP Ultrawide Hasselblad | 32MP Front
waterResistance: IP68 & IP69 water and dust resistance
pros: Massive 6000mAh silicon battery with 100W SUPERVOOC
DisplayMate A++ quad-curved 4500 nits display
Ultra-fluid OxygenOS 15 animation engine
Substantially cheaper than Samsung and Apple flagships
verdictReasonEn: Extraordinary flagship value. Delivers the latest Snapdragon 8 Elite and 6000mAh battery for hundreds less than competitors.
verdictReasonAr: قيمة رائدة استثنائية. أحدث معالج 8 إيليت مع بطارية 6000 وشاحن 100 واط بسعر يقل بمئات الدولارات عن المنافسين.

name: Samsung Galaxy A55 5G
display: 6.6" Super AMOLED, 120Hz, HDR10+, 1000 nits, 1080 x 2340 px
pros: Premium aluminum frame and Gorilla Glass Victus+ front and back
Full IP67 certified water and dust resistance
MicroSD card expansion support
Guaranteed 4 major OS updates and 5 years security
verdictReasonEn: The safest mid-range phone to buy. Built like a flagship with water resistance, great display, and reliable update support.
verdictReasonAr: أفضل خيار مضمون في الفئة المتوسطة. بناء معدني فخم، مقاومة ماء IP67، وشاشة ممتازة مع تحديثات مضمونة لسنوات.

name: Xiaomi Redmi Note 14 Pro+
display: 6.67" Curved 1.5K AMOLED, 120Hz, Dolby Vision, 3000 nits, 1220 x 2712 px
waterResistance: IP68 and IP69K extreme water and pressure resistance
pros: Gigantic 6200mAh battery with 90W charger in the box
IP68 and IP69K military-grade water pressure ratings
Real 2.5x optical telephoto camera under $350
Stunning 1.5K 120Hz curved AMOLED panel
cons: Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 is not built for heavy gaming
verdictReasonEn: Sensational specs for under $350. A 6200mAh battery, IP69 rating, and real optical zoom make this an unbeatable bargain.
verdictReasonAr: مواصفات لا تصدق بأقل من 350 دولاراً. بطارية 6200 مللي أمبير مع شاحن 90 واط، ومقاومة ماء IP69 وزوم حقيقي.

name: Realme GT 7 Pro
display: 6.78" Eco2 OLED Plus (Samsung), 120Hz, 6000 nits peak, 1264 x 2780 px
waterResistance: IP68 & IP69 with Underwater Shooting Mode
pros: Cheapest smartphone in the world with Snapdragon 8 Elite
Gigantic 6500mAh battery with 120W charging
World record 6000 nits peak display brightness
Dedicated underwater photography mode
verdictReasonEn: An insane performance bargain! If raw gaming speed and 2-day battery stamina are your top priorities, this is unchallenged at $650.
verdictReasonAr: صفقة أداء خيالية! أرخص هاتف بمعالج سنابدراجون 8 إيليت مع بطارية عملاقة 6500 وشاحن 120 واط وشاشة 6000 شمعة.

name: Apple iPhone 16
display: 6.1" Super Retina XDR OLED, 60Hz, 2000 nits, 1179 x 2556 px
os: iOS 18 (with Apple Intelligence), 6 Years of Updates
pros: Action Button and Camera Control button included
Upgraded to 8GB RAM to support Apple Intelligence
Featherweight 170g design and superb build
Spatial video capture and macro photography
cons: Screen is locked at 60Hz on an $800 phone
verdictReasonEn: Depends on your tolerance for a 60Hz screen. Excellent hardware and Apple Intelligence, but 60Hz in 2024 at $800 is hard to overlook.
verdictReasonAr: يعتمد على تقبلك لشاشة 60 هرتز. بناء رائع وخفيف ويدعم الذكاء الاصطناعي، لكن تردد 60 هرتز بسعر 800 دولار عيب واضح.

name: Google Pixel 8a
display: 6.1" Actua OLED, 120Hz, HDR, 2000 nits, 1080 x 2400 px
pros: Full 7 years of Android OS and security upgrades
Smooth 120Hz Actua display with 2000 nits brightness
Stellar computational photography with Real Tone
Clean pure software free of bloatware
cons: Battery life is average under heavy 5G data
verdictReasonEn: Best camera under $500 combined with a 7-year update guarantee. A high-value smartphone for long-term reliability.
verdictReasonAr: أفضل كاميرا بأقل من 500 دولار مع ضمان تحديثات لـ 7 سنوات كاملة ونظام أندرويد خام سلس.

name: Asus ROG Phone 9 Pro
display: 6.78" LTPO AMOLED, 185Hz Refresh Rate, 2500 nits, 1080 x 2400 px
cameras: 50MP Gimbal OIS + 32MP Telephoto (3x, OIS) + 13MP Ultrawide | 32MP Front
os: Android 15 (ROG UI / ZenUI), 4 Years of Updates
connectivity: 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, Dual USB-C ports (bottom and side)
pros: World-first 185Hz esports refresh rate display
AirTrigger ultrasonic shoulder triggers for console gaming
Dual USB-C ports allowing comfortable side-charging while playing
Programmable AniMe Vision LED matrix back panel
cons: Aggressive gaming styling is not for everyone
Heavier 227g weight and bulky form factor
Only 4 years of software update commitment
verdictReasonEn: Depends on use. The ultimate competitive mobile gaming rig with 185Hz and shoulder triggers, but overkill for non-gamers.
verdictReasonAr: حسب الاستخدام. الهاتف الأقوى على الإطلاق لمحترفي ألعاب الموبايل بتردد 185 هرتز وأزرار كتف، لكنه مكلف للمستخدم العادي.

name: Huawei Pura 70 Ultra
display: 6.8" LTPO OLED, 120Hz, 2500 nits, 1260 x 2844 px
cameras: 50MP Retractable 1-inch (Sensor-shift OIS, f/1.6-4.0) + 50MP Macro Tele (3.5x) + 40MP Ultrawide | 13MP Front
pros: Mesmerizing retractable 1-inch mechanical camera lens
Super snapshot catches sharp motion up to 300 km/h
Mind-blowing telemacro camera for microscopic detail
Kunlun Crystal Armor glass is extremely impact resistant
cons: Lacks native Google Play Services out-of-the-box
Kirin processor is less efficient than Snapdragon 8 Gen 3
verdictReasonEn: Depends on use. Mechanically one of the most brilliant camera phones ever built, but lack of native Google services limits widespread adoption.
verdictReasonAr: حسب الاستخدام. تحفة ميكانيكية وإحدى أعظم كاميرات الهواتف مع عدسة متحركة، لكن غياب خدمات جوجل رسمياً يجعله للمحترفين فقط.

name: Honor Magic 7 Pro
display: 6.8" LTPO OLED, 120Hz, 4320Hz PWM risk-free dimming, 5000 nits, 1280 x 2800 px
cameras: 50MP Variable f/1.4-2.0 (OIS) + 200MP Periscope (3x, OIS) + 50MP Ultrawide | 50MP + 3D ToF Front
os: Android 15 (MagicOS 9.0 with Google Services), 5 Years Updates
waterResistance: IP68 & IP69 water and dust resistance
pros: 200MP periscope zoom combined with 50MP variable aperture
3D ToF Face Unlock as secure as Apple Face ID
4320Hz ultra-high PWM screen protection for zero eye strain
Official Google Play services pre-installed
cons: Pill notch occupies top status bar area
verdictReasonEn: A flagship without compromise: Snapdragon 8 Elite, 200MP zoom, biometric 3D Face Unlock, and a massive 5850mAh battery.
verdictReasonAr: هاتف رائد متكامل بأقوى معالج 8 إيليت، زوم 200 ميجابكسل، بصمة وجه ثلاثية الأبعاد وبطارية 5850 مللي أمبير.

name: Oppo Find X8 Pro
display: 6.78" LTPO AMOLED, 120Hz, Dolby Vision, 4500 nits, 1264 x 2780 px
cameras: 50MP Main (OIS) + 50MP Tele (3x) + 50MP Periscope (6x) + 50MP Ultrawide Hasselblad | 32MP Front
pros: Dual periscope optical zoom system (3x portrait + 6x super tele)
Dimensity 9400 3nm chip gives astonishing efficiency and cool temps
Quick Button for instant shutter snap
5910mAh glacier battery with 80W flash charging
cons: Slightly slippery back without a protective case
ColorOS has some promotional regional push notifications
verdictReasonEn: Sensational quad 50MP camera setup featuring dual optical periscopes and peerless battery endurance. Highly recommended.
verdictReasonAr: منظومة كاميرات هاسيلبلاد خارقة بأربع عدسات 50 ميجابكسل مع عدستي زوم بيريسكوب وبطارية ضخمة 5910 مللي أمبير.

name: Motorola Edge 50 Ultra
cameras: 50MP Main (OIS) + 64MP Periscope (3x, OIS) + 50MP Ultrawide | 50MP Front AF
connectivity: 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, UWB, USB-C 3.1 DisplayPort
pros: Real Nordic Wood back or soft vegan leather finishes
Blistering 125W TurboPower charging (100% in ~20 mins)
Silky smooth 144Hz Pantone color-calibrated display
Clean near-stock Android with handy Moto gestures
cons: Snapdragon 8s is one step below top-tier 8 Gen 3
verdictReasonEn: Gorgeous natural wood styling, 125W charging speed, and clean software. A stylish and capable alternative to mainstream flagships.
verdictReasonAr: تصميم أنيق بظهر من الخشب الطبيعي، وشاحن خارق بقوة 125 واط، وشاشة 144 هرتز مع نظام أندرويد شبه خام ممتع.

name: Xiaomi Poco F6 Pro
display: 6.67" WQHD+ Flow AMOLED, 120Hz, Dolby Vision, 4000 nits, 1440 x 3200 px
pros: Stunning 2K 1440p flagship display under $500
Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 delivers tier-1 gaming horsepower
Blazing 120W HyperCharge fills battery in 19 minutes
Solid aluminum alloy metal frame
cons: Only IP54 splash resistance, no submersion rating
verdictReasonEn: Unmatched raw performance per dollar. If gaming power and a crisp 2K display are your goals under $500, this is the winning ticket.
verdictReasonAr: أقوى أداء ممكن مقابل السعر. شاشة 2K فائقة الدقة ومعالج ألعاب رائد وشاحن 120 واط بسعر أقل من 500 دولار.

name: Samsung Galaxy S24 FE
display: 6.7" Dynamic AMOLED 2X, 120Hz, HDR10+, 1900 nits, 1080 x 2340 px
os: Android 14 (One UI 6.1 with Galaxy AI), 7 Years Updates
pros: Full Galaxy AI suite included (Circle to Search, Live Translate)
7 years of guaranteed OS updates matching the S24 Ultra
Full IP68 water resistance and wireless charging
Larger 6.7-inch display upgrade over previous generation
verdictReasonEn: Delivers 90% of the flagship S24+ experience for $350 less, along with 7 years of software support and full Galaxy AI.
verdictReasonAr: يقدم 90% من تجربة فلاجشيب S24 بلس بسعر أقل بـ 350 دولاراً مع 7 سنوات كاملة من التحديثات وميزات Galaxy AI.

name: OnePlus Nord 4
display: 6.74" Fluid AMOLED, 120Hz, Ultra HDR, 2150 nits, 1240 x 2772 px
pros: Rare all-metal aluminum unibody build in 2024
Snapdragon 7+ Gen 3 punches far above its price bracket
5500mAh battery with 100W charging
Aqua Touch allows smooth screen usage with wet fingers
verdictReasonEn: Sensational mid-ranger! The premium all-metal body, top-tier 7+ Gen 3 chip, and 100W charging make it an easy recommendation.
verdictReasonAr: هيكل معدني موحد فاخر من الألمنيوم، معالج خارق وشاحن 100 واط بسعر 400 دولار يجعله صفقة رابحة.

name: Realme 13 Pro+
display: 6.7" Curved AMOLED, 120Hz, Pro-XDR, 2000 nits, 1080 x 2412 px
cameras: 50MP Sony LYT-701 (OIS) + 50MP Sony LYT-600 (3x Periscope, OIS) + 8MP Ultrawide | 32MP Front
pros: Sony LYT-600 3x periscope zoom for under $350
Claude Monet-inspired artistic glass and vegan leather backs
80W fast charging powers up to 50% in 19 minutes
cons: Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 is carried over from predecessor
verdictReasonEn: The ultimate budget portrait camera phone. Dual Sony LYT sensors with real 3x periscope zoom are unrivaled at this price.
verdictReasonAr: أفضل هاتف تصوير بورتريه بسعر اقتصادي. مستشعرات سوني مع زوم بصري 3x حقيقي وتصميم مستوحى من لوحات مونيه.

name: Motorola Moto G84 5G
connectivity: 5G, Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.1, NFC, USB-C 2.0, 3.5mm Headphone Jack
pros: 120Hz pOLED screen and 12GB RAM standard for under $200
Main camera includes real Optical Image Stabilization (OIS)
Includes 3.5mm headphone jack and microSD slot
Ultralight 166g with Pantone Viva Magenta vegan leather
verdictReasonEn: Astonishing value under $200. 12GB RAM, 256GB storage, 120Hz OLED, and an OIS camera are unbeatable at this budget.
verdictReasonAr: قيمة لا تُصدق بأقل من 200 دولار. شاشة أوليد 120 هرتز، رام 12 جيجا، سعة 256 جيجا وكاميرا بمثبت بصري حقيقي.

name: Samsung Galaxy A15 5G
display: 6.5" Super AMOLED, 90Hz, 800 nits, 1080 x 2340 px
connectivity: 5G, Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.3, NFC, USB-C 2.0, 3.5mm Headphone Jack
pros: Vibrant 90Hz Super AMOLED screen at entry level
Guaranteed 4 OS updates and 5 years security patches
Long battery stamina with 5000mAh
Includes 3.5mm audio jack and microSD support
verdictReasonEn: The safest sub-$180 recommendation thanks to 4 years of OS updates and a rich Super AMOLED screen.
verdictReasonAr: الخيار الأضمن بأقل من 180 دولاراً بفضل 4 سنوات من تحديثات النظام وشاشة سوبر أموليد الرائعة.

name: Nokia G42 5G
display: 6.56" IPS LCD, 90Hz, 560 nits, 720 x 1612 px
pros: QuickFix iFixit self-repairable screen, battery, and port
Pure bloatware-free stock Android experience
Sub-$200 5G connectivity with good battery life
cons: 720p resolution LCD screen is subpar for text clarity
Low light camera performance is weak
verdictReasonEn: Recommended specifically for fans of repairability and stock Android. Otherwise, competing models offer sharper 1080p screens.
verdictReasonAr: نوصي به خصيصاً لمن تهمه سهولة صيانة الهاتف بنفسه ونظام أندرويد الخام، وإلا فإن المنافسين يقدمون شاشات 1080p أفضل.

name: Xiaomi Redmi 13C
display: 6.74" IPS LCD, 90Hz, 600 nits, 720 x 1600 px
connectivity: 4G LTE, Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.3, NFC, USB-C 2.0, 3.5mm Jack
pros: Extremely affordable entry point with 90Hz screen
5000mAh battery easily lasts 2 days of basic use
Sleek flat-edge design and side fingerprint sensor
cons: Older eMMC 5.1 storage is slow for heavy app installs
verdictReasonEn: Acceptable only for tight budgets or secondary phones. If you can stretch $50 more, 1080p OLED models offer a massive upgrade.
verdictReasonAr: مقبول فقط للميزانيات الصارمة أو كهاتف ثانوي. إن استطعت زيادة 50 دولاراً فستحصل على شاشة 1080p أفضل بكثير.
